text:
[IDAT.2.1.1] A status is a plain integer: `0` for success, negative for an
error; no status is positive ([NERR.1.3]).

**The assignments live in [IERR.2], and only there.** This clause introduces
the type; it does not restate the dictionary. A second copy of a dictionary
cannot be kept honest, because its entire content is the numbers — drift does
not merely date such a copy, it makes it wrong about the one thing that is
normative ([STYL.2.13.3]), which is what [STYL.2.13.2] clause (b) rules out.

The type is declared in `runtime/include/libds.h`.
